ResearchTabDef.label: Homesteader
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Farm-to-table crafting, livestock, textiles, pantry storage, brewing, wells and irrigation, comforts, and electrified homestead infrastructure.

ResearchProjectDef.label: primitive homestead
ResearchProjectDef.description: Basic homesteading knowledge: curing and smoking meat, haylofts and ingredient barrels, and sowing orchard trees.

ResearchProjectDef.label: homestead food preservation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Advanced preserving techniques for boiling fruit into jam and other long-lasting pantry goods.

ResearchProjectDef.label: farmstead crafting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the grain mill, butter churn, cheese press, pickling crock, and homestead hearth for milling, dairy, pickling, and baking.

ResearchProjectDef.label: homestead storage
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cool root cellars (passive chill for stored food), preserves shelves, and reinforced crates for serious pantry and stockpile management.

ResearchProjectDef.label: homestead brewing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fermenting cider and mead, steeping herbal tea, and keeping bees for a steady supply of honey.

ResearchProjectDef.label: homestead comforts
ResearchProjectDef.description: The finer side of frontier life: quilted beds, log benches, rocking chairs, oil lamps, wood stoves, porch games, and 27 monuments and statues.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced homestead
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bringing electricity to the homestead with wood-fired generators and mature farm-to-table infrastructure.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wellcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Digging and lining wells, coopering rain barrels, and building cisterns: the craft of finding water and keeping it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: irrigation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Trenching drawn water into cropland to work it into rich, dark irrigated soil that grows anything faster.

ResearchProjectDef.label: waterworks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Deeper shafts, taller tanks: reinforced deep wells that tap the water table and elevated towers that stockpile serious reserves.

ResearchProjectDef.label: homestead livestock
ResearchProjectDef.description: Chicken coops for steady eggs, goat pens for dairy milk, and mash recipes to keep the yard flock productive.

ResearchProjectDef.label: homestead textiles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow flax, spin fiber or wool into homespun cloth, and weave farmhouse quilts for quilted beds.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soil and cold storage
ResearchProjectDef.description: Compost heaps and composted soil for richer fields, plus icehouses and springhouses for passive cold pantry space.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pantry craft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Canning kitchens and mason jars for sealed stew and jam, a cider press for orchard juice, and a soap wash tub for a proper scrub.
